criteria.requirement: Meet the complete public built-in combination-tree contract without recursive traversal, flattening opaque subclasses or changing recursionlimit. Preserve per-node builtin float(sum(...)), argument convention, leaf order, dynamic node-entry tuple behavior, shared DAG multiplicity, leaf exceptions and bounded ValueError cycles. Independent business and full frozen 185-main/15-subtest upstream regression must pass.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests within library/tests/test_tenacity.py and cite actual candidate implementation and test files. Claims without delivered tests are insufficient.
Change only the explicitly authorized source and public test files, without dependencies, pytest controls, unrelated lifecycle changes or global recursion-limit changes.

Deliver meaningful public regression tests within the authorized test paths that fail on the pinned original and pass with the change. Preserve the frozen original tests, test controls, and compatibility behavior; cite actual delivered test files. Controller-owned verification is independent evidence and does not replace delivered public tests.

comparison: Evaluate factual grounding, business behavior and stated constraints; accept equivalent correct answers without keyword, verbosity or reference-answer matching.
